SELECT sdn.ID, sdn.source_id AS sourceId, sdn.source_type AS sourceType, sdn.code, sdn.source_code AS sourceCode, sdn.customer_id AS customerId, sdn.customer_name AS customerName, sdn.approve_status AS approveStatus, sdn.invalid_status AS invalidStatus, sdn.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus, sdn.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, sdn.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, sdn.warehouse_org_id AS warehouseOrgId, sdn.warehouse_org_name AS warehouseOrgName, sdn.is_allow_outstock AS isAllowOutstock, sdn.remark, sdn.seller_name AS sellerName, sdn.require_date AS requireDate, sdn.plan_delivery_date AS planDeliveryDate, sdn.actual_delivery_date AS actualDeliveryDate, sdn.pack_date AS packDate, sdn.approve_user_name AS approveUserName, sdn.create_user_name AS createUserName, sdn.create_time AS createTime, sdn.transfer_warehouse_ids, sdn.declare_status AS declareStatus, sdnd.ID AS detailId, sdnd.source_detail_id AS sourceDetailId, sdnd.sku_id AS skuId, sdnd.sku_no AS skuNo, sdnd.delivery_qty AS deliveryQty, sdnd.customer_po AS customerPO, sdnd.to_country AS toCountry, sdnd.picking_qty AS pickedQty, sd.box_qty as salesQty, pd.name as productName, pd.unit_name as unit, CASE WHEN total.total_delivery_qty = total.total_picked_qty THEN '已生成' WHEN total.total_picked_qty > 0 THEN '部分生成' ELSE '未生成' END AS generationPickStatus FROM so_delivery_notice sdn LEFT JOIN so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd ON sdn.ID = sdnd.main_id and sdnd.is_deleted=false INNER JOIN (SELECT main_id,SUM(delivery_qty) AS total_delivery_qty,SUM(picking_qty) AS total_picked_qty FROM so_delivery_notice_detail WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY main_id ) total ON sdn.ID = total.main_id
LEFT JOIN erp_oms.so_detail sd on sd.id = sdnd.source_detail_id and sd.is_deleted= false LEFT JOIN erp_plm.product_detail pd on sdnd.sku_id= pd.id and pd.is_deleted=false
LEFT JOIN so_detail sd on sd.id = sdnd.source_detail_id and sd.is_deleted= false LEFT JOIN product_detail pd on sdnd.sku_id= pd.id and pd.is_deleted=false
WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and sdn.is_deleted = FALSE
${params.permissionSql}
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
sdn.create_time desc

SELECT DISTINCT sdn.id, sdn.code, sdn.source_code AS soCode, sdn.seller_name, sdn.warehouse_id, sdn.warehouse_name, sdn.customer_name, sdn.approve_status, sdn.create_time FROM so_delivery_notice sdn LEFT JOIN so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd ON sdn.id = sdnd.main_id AND sdnd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sdn.is_deleted = FALSE AND sdn.invalid_status = FALSE AND sdn.approve_status = 'approve'
AND sdnd.sku_no = #{skuNo}
AND sdn.code ILIKE concat('%', #{code}::text ,'%')
ORDER BY sdn.create_time

-- b2b销售订单冻结 select sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, si.virtual_warehouse_id, si.warehouse_id, 'soInfo' as source_type, si.id as source_id, si.code as source_code, sd.id as source_detail_id, COALESCE(sd.frozen_time,sd.create_time) as bill_date, COALESCE(sd.frozen_time,sd.create_time) as trade_time, sd.frozen_qty as qty from so_info si inner join so_detail sd on si.id = sd.main_id and sd.is_deleted = false and sd.frozen_qty > 0 where si.is_deleted = false and si.virtual_warehouse_id != '' union all -- 发货通知单冻结 select * from ( select sdnd.sku_id, sdnd.sku_no, sdn.virtual_warehouse_id, sdn.warehouse_id, 'soDeliveryNotice' as source_type, sdn.id as source_id, sdn.code as source_code, sdnd.id as source_detail_id, sdn.create_time as bill_date, sdn.create_time as trade_time, case when sdn.approve_status = 'approve' then sdnd.picking_qty else sdnd.last_picking_qty end as qty from so_delivery_notice sdn inner join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false and sdn.virtual_warehouse_id != '' and sdn.invalid_status = false where sdn.is_deleted = false ) as soDelivery where soDelivery.qty > 0 -- 加工单出库(发货通知单下推) union all select md.sku_id, md.sku_no, sdn.virtual_warehouse_id, sdn.warehouse_id, 'machineInfo' as source_type, mi.id as source_id, mi.code as source_code, md.id as source_detail_id, mi.approve_time as bill_date, mi.approve_time as trade_time, md.qty as qty from machine_info mi inner join machine_detail md on md.main_id = mi.id and md.is_deleted = false and mi.approve_status = 'approve' and mi.source_type = 'soDeliveryNotice' and md.qty > 0 inner join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdnd.id = md.source_detail_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false inner join so_delivery_notice sdn on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdn.is_deleted = false and sdn.virtual_warehouse_id != '' where mi.is_deleted = false -- 加工单出库(销售订单下推) union all select md.sku_id, md.sku_no, si.virtual_warehouse_id, si.warehouse_id, 'machineInfo' as source_type, mi.id as source_id, mi.code as source_code, md.id as source_detail_id, mi.approve_time as bill_date, mi.approve_time as trade_time, md.qty as qty from machine_info mi inner join machine_detail md on md.main_id = mi.id and md.is_deleted = false and mi.approve_status = 'approve' and mi.source_type = 'soInfo' and md.qty > 0 inner join machine_ref_so mrs on md.id = mrs.machine_detail_id and mi.id = mrs.machine_id and mrs.is_deleted = false inner join so_info si on si.id = mrs.so_id and si.is_deleted = false and si.virtual_warehouse_id != '' where mi.is_deleted = false --直接调拨单出库 union all select tid.sku_id, tid.sku_no, sdn.virtual_warehouse_id, sdn.warehouse_id, 'transferInfo' as source_type, ti.id as source_id, ti.code as source_code, tid.id as source_detail_id, ti.approve_time as bill_date, ti.approve_time as trade_time, tid.qty as qty from transfer_info ti inner join transfer_info_detail tid on ti.id = tid.main_id and tid.is_deleted = false and ti.approve_status = 'approve' and tid.qty > 0 inner join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdnd.id = tid.source_detail_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false inner join so_delivery_notice sdn on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdn.is_deleted = false and sdn.virtual_warehouse_id != '' and tid.out_warehouse_id = sdn.warehouse_id where ti.is_deleted = false union all -- 销售出库单出库 select sod.sku_id, sod.sku_no, sdn.virtual_warehouse_id, sdn.warehouse_id, 'soOutstock' as source_type, so.id as source_id, so.code as source_code, sod.id as source_detail_id, so.approve_time as bill_date, so.approve_time as trade_time, sod.actual_qty as qty from so_outstock so inner join so_outstock_detail sod on so.id = sod.main_id and sod.is_deleted = false and so.approve_status = 'approve' and sod.actual_qty > 0 inner join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdnd.id = sod.source_detail_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false inner join so_delivery_notice sdn on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdn.is_deleted = false and sdn.virtual_warehouse_id != '' and sod.warehouse_id = sdn.warehouse_id where so.is_deleted = false

SELECT sdn.id, sdnd.id as detailId, sdn.source_id as soId, sdn.source_code as soCode, sdnd.sku_id as skuId, sdnd.sku_no as skuNo, sdnd.platform_sku_no as platformSkuNo, sdnd.delivery_qty as deliveryQty from so_delivery_notice sdn LEFT JOIN so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id where sdn.is_deleted = false and sdnd.is_deleted = false and sdnd.id in
#{id}

SELECT sdn.id AS sourceId, wc.id AS boxId, wc.box_no AS boxNo, wcd.sku_id AS skuId, wcd.sku_no AS skuNo, wcd.fn_sku AS fnSku, wcd.pack_qty AS packQty FROM so_delivery_notice sdn INNER JOIN packing_task pt ON pt.source_id = sdn.id AND pt.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN wms_carton wc ON wc.packing_task_id = pt.id AND wc.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN wms_carton_detail wcd ON wcd.main_id = wc.id AND wcd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sdn.is_deleted = FALSE
AND sdn.id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY sdn.code, CAST(wc.box_no AS INTEGER), wcd.sku_no

select * from ( -- 1. 公共子查询：获取需要处理的发货通知明细（等待报关 + 有箱子） WITH qualified_details AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT sdn.id AS source_id, sdn.code AS source_code, sdnd.id AS detail_id, sdnd.sku_id, sdnd.sku_no, sdnd.delivery_qty FROM so_delivery_notice sdn JOIN so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd ON sdnd.main_id = sdn.id AND sdnd.is_deleted = false WHERE sdn.is_deleted = false AND sdn.declare_status = 'wait' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM packing_task_detail ptd JOIN packing_task pt ON pt.id = ptd.main_id AND pt.is_deleted = false JOIN wms_carton wc ON wc.packing_task_id = pt.id AND wc.is_deleted = false AND wc.box_no IS NOT NULL WHERE ptd.is_deleted = false AND ptd.source_detail_id = sdnd.id ) ), -- 2. BOM 信息（物化） has_bom AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT fpbi.id AS bom_id, fpbi.bom_version, fpbs.parent_sku_id, fpbs.parent_sku_no, fpbs.sku_id, fpbs.sku_no, fpbs.quantity FROM foreign_product_bom_info fpbi JOIN foreign_product_bom_sku fpbs ON fpbi.id = fpbs.bom_id WHERE fpbi.is_deleted = false AND fpbs.is_deleted = false ) -- ========== 分支 1：无 BOM 或组合申报类型为 'combine' ========== SELECT qd.source_id AS sourceId, qd.source_code AS sourceCode, 'soDeliveryNotice' AS sourceType, qd.detail_id AS sourceDetailId, qd.sku_id AS skuId, qd.sku_no AS skuNo, '' AS bomVersion, fpl.customs_code AS customsCode, fpl.declare_chinese_name AS declareChineseName, fpl.declare_element AS declareElement, fpl.declare_unit AS declareUnit, fpl.declare_price AS price, qd.delivery_qty AS qty, (qd.delivery_qty * fpl.declare_price) AS totalPrice, fpl.declare_currency AS declareCurrency, fpl.declare_currency_symbol AS declareCurrencySymbol, fpl.source_country AS sourceCountry, fpl.source_cargo AS sourceCargo, fpl.exemption FROM qualified_details qd LEFT JOIN has_bom hb ON hb.parent_sku_id = qd.sku_id LEFT JOIN foreign_product_logistics fpl ON fpl.sku_id = qd.sku_id AND fpl.is_deleted = false WHERE (hb.bom_id IS NULL OR fpl.combination_declare_type = 'combine') UNION ALL -- ========== 分支 2：有 BOM 且组合申报类型为 'split' ========== SELECT qd.source_id AS sourceId, qd.source_code AS sourceCode, 'soDeliveryNotice' AS sourceType, qd.detail_id AS sourceDetailId, hb.sku_id AS skuId, hb.sku_no AS skuNo, hb.bom_version AS bomVersion, fpl_child.customs_code AS customsCode, fpl_child.declare_chinese_name AS declareChineseName, fpl_child.declare_element AS declareElement, fpl_child.declare_unit AS declareUnit, fpl_child.declare_price AS price, qd.delivery_qty * hb.quantity AS qty, (qd.delivery_qty * hb.quantity * fpl_child.declare_price) AS totalPrice, fpl_child.declare_currency AS declareCurrency, fpl_child.declare_currency_symbol AS declareCurrencySymbol, fpl_child.source_country AS sourceCountry, fpl_child.source_cargo AS sourceCargo, fpl_child.exemption FROM qualified_details qd JOIN has_bom hb ON hb.parent_sku_id = qd.sku_id JOIN foreign_product_logistics fpl_child ON fpl_child.sku_id = hb.sku_id AND fpl_child.is_deleted = false AND fpl_child.combination_declare_type = 'split' ) as sdnd where ${params.sqlMap.default} ORDER BY sdnd.sourceId DESC

select * from ( WITH carton_detail AS ( SELECT wc.packing_task_id, wc.box_no, wcd.sku_id, wcd.sku_no, COALESCE(wcd.fn_sku, '') AS fn_sku, SUM(COALESCE(wcd.pack_qty, 0))::INTEGER AS pack_qty FROM wms_carton wc INNER JOIN wms_carton_detail wcd ON wcd.main_id = wc.id AND wcd.is_deleted = false AND COALESCE(wcd.pack_qty, 0) > 0 WHERE wc.is_deleted = false AND wc.box_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wc.packing_task_id, wc.box_no, wcd.sku_id, wcd.sku_no, COALESCE(wcd.fn_sku, '') ), has_bom AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT fpbi.id AS bom_id, fpbi.bom_version, fpbs.parent_sku_id, fpbs.parent_sku_no, fpbs.sku_id, fpbs.sku_no, fpbs.quantity FROM foreign_product_bom_info fpbi JOIN foreign_product_bom_sku fpbs ON fpbi.id = fpbs.bom_id WHERE fpbi.is_deleted = false AND fpbs.is_deleted = false and fpbi.state = 4 ) -- 分支1：不需要拆分的明细（无BOM 或 combination_declare_type = 'combine'） SELECT sdn.id AS sourceId, sdn.code AS sourceCode, 'soDeliveryNotice' AS sourceType, sdnd.id AS sourceDetailId, sdn.source_id AS businessId, sdn.source_code AS businessCode, sdnd.sku_id AS skuId, sdnd.sku_no AS skuNo, '' AS parentSkuId, '' AS bomVersion, sdnd.platform_sku_no AS platformSkuNo, cd.pack_qty AS qty, cd.box_no AS boxNo, ci.country_id AS countryId, sdn.warehouse_id AS fromWarehouseId, sdn.warehouse_name AS fromWarehouseName, sdn.warehouse_org_id AS fromWarehouseOrgId, sdn.warehouse_org_name AS fromWarehouseOrgName, sdn.transfer_warehouse_ids AS transferWarehouseIds, sdn.sales_org_id AS salesOrgId, sdn.sales_org_name AS salesOrgName FROM so_delivery_notice sdn INNER JOIN so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd ON sdnd.main_id = sdn.id AND sdnd.is_deleted = false INNER JOIN packing_task_detail ptd ON ptd.source_detail_id = sdnd.id AND ptd.is_deleted = false INNER JOIN packing_task pt ON pt.id = ptd.main_id AND pt.is_deleted = false and pt.packing_status = 'packed' INNER JOIN carton_detail cd ON cd.packing_task_id = pt.id AND cd.sku_id = sdnd.sku_id AND (COALESCE(ptd.fn_sku, '') = '' OR cd.fn_sku = COALESCE(ptd.fn_sku, '')) LEFT JOIN customer_info ci ON ci.id = sdn.customer_id AND ci.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN has_bom hb ON hb.parent_sku_id = sdnd.sku_id LEFT JOIN foreign_product_logistics fpl_parent ON fpl_parent.sku_id = sdnd.sku_id AND fpl_parent.is_deleted = false WHERE sdn.is_deleted = false AND sdn.declare_status = 'wait' AND (hb.bom_id IS NULL OR fpl_parent.combination_declare_type = 'combine') UNION ALL -- 分支2：需要拆分的明细（有BOM 且 combination_declare_type = 'split'） SELECT sdn.id AS sourceId, sdn.code AS sourceCode, 'soDeliveryNotice' AS sourceType, sdnd.id AS sourceDetailId, sdn.source_id AS businessId, sdn.source_code AS businessCode, hb.sku_id AS skuId, -- 子SKU ID hb.sku_no AS skuNo, -- 子SKU 编码 hb.parent_sku_id AS parentSkuId, hb.bom_version AS bomVersion, '' AS platformSkuNo, -- 子SKU无平台编码，置空 cd.pack_qty * quantity AS qty, -- 原箱数量（每个子SKU继承相同数量） cd.box_no AS boxNo, ci.country_id AS countryId, sdn.warehouse_id AS fromWarehouseId, sdn.warehouse_name AS fromWarehouseName, sdn.warehouse_org_id AS fromWarehouseOrgId, sdn.warehouse_org_name AS fromWarehouseOrgName, sdn.transfer_warehouse_ids AS transferWarehouseIds, sdn.sales_org_id AS salesOrgId, sdn.sales_org_name AS salesOrgName FROM so_delivery_notice sdn INNER JOIN so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd ON sdnd.main_id = sdn.id AND sdnd.is_deleted = false INNER JOIN packing_task_detail ptd ON ptd.source_detail_id = sdnd.id AND ptd.is_deleted = false INNER JOIN packing_task pt ON pt.id = ptd.main_id AND pt.is_deleted = false and pt.packing_status = 'packed' INNER JOIN carton_detail cd ON cd.packing_task_id = pt.id AND cd.sku_id = sdnd.sku_id -- 箱子中实际装的是父SKU AND (COALESCE(ptd.fn_sku, '') = '' OR cd.fn_sku = COALESCE(ptd.fn_sku, '')) INNER JOIN has_bom hb ON hb.parent_sku_id = sdnd.sku_id INNER JOIN foreign_product_logistics fpl_parent ON fpl_parent.sku_id = hb.sku_id AND fpl_parent.is_deleted = false AND fpl_parent.combination_declare_type = 'split' -- 仅拆分类型 LEFT JOIN customer_info ci ON ci.id = sdn.customer_id AND ci.is_deleted = false WHERE sdn.is_deleted = false AND sdn.declare_status = 'wait') sn where 1 = 1 and
(sn.sourceId = #{item.id} and sn.sourceDetailId = #{item.detailId} and sn.skuId = #{item.skuId})
ORDER BY sn.sourceCode, sn.boxNo, sn.skuNo
